# app.R — application shell

# app.R — application shell

ui <- navbarPage(

    tags$img(src = "logo.png", class = "navbar-logo"),

    tags$link(
      rel = "stylesheet",

      href = "styles.css"

    "Extinction Dynamics",
    extinctionUI("extinctions")

    "Robustness",

      n = length(connectance_plots)
    )

  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

    "extinctions",
    initial_community = initial_community
  )

  scenarioMatchingServer("scenario_matching")
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

content:
# Initial food-web definition and cheddar Community object.
# Keep species names exactly aligned with files in www/pics/ if using images.

foodweb_graph <- igraph::make_graph(c(
  # Apex level
  "Tyrannosaurus rex", "Allosaurus",
  "Tyrannosaurus rex", "Velociraptor",

  # Secondary -> Primary
  "Velociraptor", "Triceratops",

  "Allosaurus", "Stegosaurus",
  "Allosaurus", "Triceratops",

  # Primary -> Producers
  "Stegosaurus", "Cycads",
  "Stegosaurus", "Ferns",
  "Triceratops", "Ferns"
), directed = TRUE)

foodweb_nodes <- data.frame(node = igraph::V(foodweb_graph)$name)
foodweb_edges <- igraph::as_data_frame(foodweb_graph, what = "edges")
names(foodweb_edges) <- c("consumer", "resource")

initial_community <- cheddar::Community(
  properties = list(title = "foodweb"),
  nodes = foodweb_nodes,
  trophic.links = foodweb_edges
)

# ============================================================
# FOOD WEB IMAGE LOADING AND PLOTTING HELPERS
# Preserves image proportions and trophic-level orientation.
# ============================================================

load_species_images <- function(species, image_dir = "www/pics") {
  
  imgs <- lapply(species, function(sp) {
    
    path <- file.path(image_dir, paste0(sp, ".png"))
    
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    img <- png::readPNG(path)
    
    # Convert grayscale images to RGBA.
    if (is.matrix(img)) {
      rgba <- array(1, dim = c(nrow(img), ncol(img), 4))
      for (ch in 1:3) {
        rgba[, , ch] <- img
      }
      return(rgba)
    }
    
    channels <- dim(img)[3]
    
    # Convert grayscale + alpha to RGBA.
    if (channels == 2) {
      rgba <- array(1, dim = c(dim(img)[1], dim(img)[2], 4))
      
      for (ch in 1:3) {
        rgba[, , ch] <- img[, , 1]
      }
      
      rgba[, , 4] <- img[, , 2]
      return(rgba)
    }
    
    # Convert RGB to RGBA.
    if (channels == 3) {
      rgba <- array(1, dim = c(dim(img)[1], dim(img)[2], 4))
      rgba[, , 1:3] <- img
      return(rgba)
    }
    
    img
  })
  
  names(imgs) <- species
  imgs
}


# ============================================================
# PLOT FOOD WEB
# ============================================================

plot_foodweb <- function(
    community,
    img_list = list(),
    main = "Food Web Cascade",
    image_width_in = 0.65,
    image_max_height_in = 0.85
) {
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Handle extinction.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (is.null(community)) {
    plot.new()
    title(main)
    text(0.5, 0.5, "Entire ecosystem extinct", cex = 1.4)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  species <- get_species(community)
  
  if (length(species) == 0L) {
    plot.new()
    title(main)
    text(0.5, 0.5, "All species extinct", cex = 1.4)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Build the food-web graph.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  predation <- cheddar::PredationMatrix(community)
  
  graph <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
    predation,
    mode = "directed",
    diag = FALSE
  )
  
  if (igraph::vcount(graph) != length(species)) {
    plot.new()
    title(main)
    text(0.5, 0.5, "Could not align network nodes", cex = 1.1)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  igraph::V(graph)$name <- species
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Generate a network layout.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  layout <- tryCatch(
    igraph::layout_with_sugiyama(graph)$layout,
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(layout) ||
      nrow(layout) != length(species) ||
      any(!is.finite(layout))) {
    
    layout <- igraph::layout_nicely(graph)
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Use trophic levels for vertical placement.
  # Higher trophic levels should appear at the TOP.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  tl <- tryCatch(
    cheddar::TrophicLevels(community),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (!is.null(tl) && !is.null(names(tl))) {
    
    matched <- match(species, names(tl))
    
    if (all(!is.na(matched))) {
      
      trophic_y <- as.numeric(tl[matched])
      
      if (all(is.finite(trophic_y))) {
        layout[, 2] <- trophic_y
      }
    }
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Normalize node coordinates.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  x_range <- range(layout[, 1], finite = TRUE)
  y_range <- range(layout[, 2], finite = TRUE)
  
  if (diff(x_range) > 0) {
    
    layout[, 1] <- 0.08 +
      (layout[, 1] - x_range[1]) /
      diff(x_range) * 0.84
    
  } else {
    
    layout[, 1] <- 0.50
  }
  
  # Flip the vertical positions so higher trophic levels are at the top.
  if (diff(y_range) > 0) {
    layout[, 2] <- 0.85 -
      (layout[, 2] - y_range[1]) /
      diff(y_range) * 0.70
  } else {
    layout[, 2] <- 0.50
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Preserve plotting parameters.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)
  
  par(
    mar = c(4, 3, 5, 3),
    xpd = FALSE
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Create one plotting region.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0, 1),
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    axes = FALSE,
    asp = 1,
    main = main,
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i"
  )
  
  # Actual physical plot dimensions and user-coordinate ranges.
  # These are used to convert inches into plotting coordinates.
  usr <- par("usr")
  pin <- par("pin")
  
  x_units_per_inch <- diff(usr[1:2]) / pin[1]
  y_units_per_inch <- diff(usr[3:4]) / pin[2]
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Draw directed food-web edges.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  edges <- igraph::as_edgelist(graph, names = TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(edges) > 0L) {
    
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges))) {
      
      from <- match(edges[i, 1], species)
      to   <- match(edges[i, 2], species)
      
      if (!is.na(from) && !is.na(to)) {
        
        arrows(
          layout[from, 1],
          layout[from, 2],
          layout[to, 1],
          layout[to, 2],
          col = "gray70",
          length = 0.08,
          lwd = 1.5
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Draw images without stretching or squashing.
  # Image sizes are calculated in physical inches first.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  for (i in seq_along(species)) {
    
    sp <- species[i]
    img <- img_list[[sp]]
    
    x <- layout[i, 1]
    y <- layout[i, 2]
    
    if (!is.null(img)) {
      
      img_h <- dim(img)[1]
      img_w <- dim(img)[2]
      
      # Original pixel aspect ratio.
      aspect <- img_h / img_w
      
      # Choose physical dimensions while preserving proportions.
      draw_width_in <- min(
        image_width_in,
        image_max_height_in / aspect
      )
      
      draw_height_in <- draw_width_in * aspect
      
      # Convert physical dimensions to plot coordinates.
      width <- draw_width_in * x_units_per_inch
      height <- draw_height_in * y_units_per_inch
      
      # Keep the complete image within the plot region.
      x <- min(max(x, usr[1] + width / 2),
               usr[2] - width / 2)
      
      y <- min(max(y, usr[3] + height / 2),
               usr[4] - height / 2)
      
      rasterImage(
        img,
        x - width / 2,
        y - height / 2,
        x + width / 2,
        y + height / 2,
        interpolate = TRUE
      )
      
      # Place the label below the image.
      label_y <- y - height / 2 -
        0.025 * y_units_per_inch
      
      text(
        x,
        max(usr[3] + 0.02 * diff(usr[3:4]), label_y),
        labels = sp,
        font = 2,
        cex = 0.75
      )
      
    } else {
      
      # Fallback when an image is missing.
      points(
        x, y,
        pch = 21,
        bg = "white",
        cex = 2.8
      )
      
      text(
        x,
        max(usr[3] + 0.02 * diff(usr[3:4]),
            y - 0.045 * diff(usr[3:4])),
        labels = sp,
        font = 2,
        cex = 0.8
      )
    }
  }
  
  invisible(NULL)
}

content:
# R/scenario_matching.R

# Load relevant data products
tss <- readRDS("data/tss.rds")
extinction_edge <- readRDS("data/extinction_edge.rds")
post_edge <- readRDS("data/post_edge.rds")
pre_edge <- readRDS("data/pre_edge.rds")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Helper: plot a network using shared node positions
# --------------------------------------------------


plot_extinction_network <- function(
    edges,
    plot_title,
    shared_layout,
    retained_species = NULL
) {
  
  edges <- unique(
    as.data.frame(
      edges[, c("consumer", "resource"), drop = FALSE]
    )
  )
  
  if (nrow(edges) == 0L) {
    plot.new()
    title(main = plot_title)
    text(0.5, 0.5, "No network data available")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  present_nodes <- unique(c(
    as.character(edges$consumer),
    as.character(edges$resource)
  ))
  
  graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    edges,
    directed = TRUE,
    vertices = data.frame(name = present_nodes)
  )
  
  node_names <- igraph::V(graph)$name
  
  network_layout <- shared_layout[
    node_names,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Default: all nodes teal
  node_colours <- rep("#005C53", length(node_names))
  
  # If a retained-species vector is supplied, colour by retention
  if (!is.null(retained_species)) {
    node_colours <- ifelse(
      node_names %in% retained_species,
      "#005C53",
      "#DB8655"
    )
  }
  
  plot(
    graph,
    layout = network_layout,
    main = plot_title,
    vertex.size = 7,
    vertex.label = NA,
    vertex.color = node_colours,
    edge.arrow.size = 0.25,
    edge.color = "grey65",
    margin = 0.05
  )
  
  # Add a legend only to the retention-coloured network
  if (!is.null(retained_species)) {
    legend(
      "topleft",
      legend = c(
        "Retained in simulation",
        "Absent from simulation"
      ),
      col = c("#005C53", "#DB8655"),
      pch = 19,
      pt.cex = 1.1,
      bty = "n",
      cex = 0.8
    )
  }
}



# --------------------------------------------------
# UI
# --------------------------------------------------

scenarioMatchingUI <- function(id) {
  
  ns <- NS(id)
  
  fluidPage(
    
    titlePanel("Best-fit Extinction Mechanism"),
    
    sidebarLayout(
      
      # LEFT SIDEBAR
      sidebarPanel(
        width = 4,
        
        selectInput(
          ns("mechanism"),
          "Extinction mechanism",
          choices = NULL
        ),
        
        # Information box
        wellPanel(
          h4("About this comparison"),
          
          p(
            "Compare the simulated final community against ",
            "the known post-extinction community."
          ),
          
          p(
            "The pre-extinction network is provided as a ",
            "reference for the original community structure."
          ),
          
          tags$hr(),
          
          h5("Node TSS interpretation"),
          
          p(
            strong("+1: "),
            "Perfect agreement."
          ),
          
          p(
            strong("0: "),
            "No discriminatory skill."
          ),
          
          p(
            strong("-1: "),
            "Perfectly incorrect predictions."
          ),
          
          p(
            class = "text-muted",
            "Higher scores indicate better agreement ",
            "between predicted and observed outcomes."
          )
        ),
        
        # Pre-extinction network in sidebar
        h4("Known pre-extinction network"),
        
        plotOutput(
          ns("pre_network"),
          height = "450px"
        )
      ),
      
      # MAIN PANEL
      mainPanel(
        width = 8,
        
        # Two networks in one row
        
        fluidRow(
          
          column(
            width = 6,
            
            h4("Simulated species retention"),
            
            plotOutput(
              ns("simulated_network"),
              height = "420px"
            )
          ),
          
          column(
            width = 6,
            
            h4("Known post-extinction network"),
            
            plotOutput(
              ns("post_network"),
              height = "420px"
            )
          )
        ),
        
        tags$hr(),
        
        # Selected mechanism's Node TSS
        h3("Model fit"),
        
        uiOutput(ns("selected_score")),
        
        tags$hr(),
        
        # Collapsible comparison table
        checkboxInput(
          ns("show_table"),
          "Show comparison of all extinction mechanisms",
          value = FALSE
        ),
        
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.show_table == true",
          ns = ns,
          
          h4("Node TSS ranking"),
          
          p(
            "Mechanisms are ordered from highest to lowest ",
            "Node TSS. The arrow identifies the selected mechanism."
          ),
          
          tableOutput(ns("tss_table"))
        )
      )
    )
  )
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# Server
# --------------------------------------------------

scenarioMatchingServer <- function(id) {
  
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    # ----------------------------------------------
    # Validate inputs
    # ----------------------------------------------
    
    stopifnot(
      all(c(
        "extinction_mechanism",
        "tss_node"
      ) %in% names(tss)),
      
      all(c(
        "consumer",
        "resource"
      ) %in% names(pre_edge)),
      
      all(c(
        "consumer",
        "resource"
      ) %in% names(post_edge)),
      
      all(c(
        "extinction_mechanism",
        "consumer",
        "resource"
      ) %in% names(extinction_edge))
    )
    
    mechanisms <- sort(
      unique(as.character(tss$extinction_mechanism))
    )
    
    # Update selector with available mechanisms
    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "mechanism",
      choices = mechanisms,
      selected = mechanisms[1]
    )
    
    
    # ----------------------------------------------
    # Shared layout for all networks
    # ----------------------------------------------
    
    all_edges <- unique(rbind(
      pre_edge[, c("consumer", "resource"), drop = FALSE],
      post_edge[, c("consumer", "resource"), drop = FALSE],
      extinction_edge[, c("consumer", "resource"), drop = FALSE]
    ))
    
    all_graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
      all_edges,
      directed = TRUE
    )
    
    set.seed(42)
    
    shared_layout <- igraph::layout_with_fr(all_graph)
    
    rownames(shared_layout) <- igraph::V(all_graph)$name
    
    
    # ----------------------------------------------
    # Known pre-extinction network
    # ----------------------------------------------
    
    output$pre_network <- renderPlot({
      
      plot_extinction_network(
        edges = pre_edge,
        plot_title = "Known pre-extinction",
        shared_layout = shared_layout
      )
      
    })
    
    
    # ----------------------------------------------
    # Known post-extinction network
    # ----------------------------------------------
    
    output$post_network <- renderPlot({
      
      plot_extinction_network(
        edges = post_edge,
        plot_title = "Known post-extinction",
        shared_layout = shared_layout
      )
      
    })
    
    
    # ----------------------------------------------
    # Simulated network for selected mechanism
    # ----------------------------------------------
    
    
    output$simulated_network <- renderPlot({
      
      req(input$mechanism)
      
      # The selected simulation's final edge list
      simulated_edges <- extinction_edge[
        extinction_edge$extinction_mechanism ==
          input$mechanism,
        c("consumer", "resource"),
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
      validate(
        need(
          nrow(simulated_edges) > 0L,
          "No simulated network found for this mechanism."
        )
      )
      
      # Species present in the simulated final community
      retained_species <- unique(c(
        as.character(simulated_edges$consumer),
        as.character(simulated_edges$resource)
      ))
      
      # Plot the KNOWN post-extinction structure,
      # coloured by the simulation's retained species
      plot_extinction_network(
        edges = post_edge,
        plot_title = paste(
          "Post-extinction structure:",
          gsub("_", " ", input$mechanism)
        ),
        shared_layout = shared_layout,
        retained_species = retained_species
      )
      
    })
    
    
    
    # ----------------------------------------------
    # Selected mechanism's Node TSS
    # ----------------------------------------------
    
    output$selected_score <- renderUI({
      
      req(input$mechanism)
      
      score <- tss[
        tss$extinction_mechanism == input$mechanism,
        "tss_node",
        drop = TRUE
      ]
      
      req(length(score) > 0L)
      
      score <- score[1]
      
      score_colour <- if (is.na(score)) {
        "#777777"
      } else if (score >= 0.4) {
        "#62771B"
      } else if (score >= 0) {
        "#042940"
      } else {
        "#DB8655"
      }
      
      fluidRow(
        
        column(
          width = 7,
          
          wellPanel(
            h4(
              gsub("_", " ", input$mechanism)
            ),
            
            p("Node True Skill Statistic"),
            
            h1(
              if (is.na(score)) {
                "NA"
              } else {
                sprintf("%.3f", score)
              },
              style = paste0(
                "color: ",
                score_colour,
                "; font-weight: bold;"
              )
            ),
            
            p(
              class = "text-muted",
              if (is.na(score)) {
                "Node TSS is unavailable for this mechanism."
              } else if (score == 1) {
                "Perfect agreement."
              } else if (score == -1) {
                "Perfectly incorrect predictions."
              } else if (score > 0) {
                "Positive agreement with the observed outcome."
              } else if (score == 0) {
                "No discriminatory skill."
              } else {
                "Negative agreement with the observed outcome."
              }
            )
          )
        )
      )
      
    })
    
    
    # ----------------------------------------------
    # Optional comparison table
    # ----------------------------------------------
    
    output$tss_table <- renderTable({
      
      result <- tss[
        ,
        c(
          "extinction_mechanism",
          "tss_node"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
      result$Selected <- ifelse(
        result$extinction_mechanism == input$mechanism,
        "\u25B6",
        ""
      )
      
      result <- result[
        order(-result$tss_node, na.last = TRUE),
        c(
          "Selected",
          "extinction_mechanism",
          "tss_node"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
      names(result) <- c(
        "",
        "Extinction mechanism",
        "Node TSS"
      )
      
      result$`Node TSS` <- round(
        result$`Node TSS`,
        3
      )
      
      result
      
    }, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE)
    
  })
}

content:
library(ggplot2)

# for trophic level colours
cols <- c(0.99, 1.99, 2.99, 3.99, 4.99, 5.99, 6.95, 1000)
tl_cols <- c("#DDDDDD", "#1E7548", "#32c479", 
             "#47799d", "#69B3E7", "#A9431E", 
             "#f05e29", "#5F249F")

accent_col <- "#5e5e5e"

plot_col <- "#DB8655"

figure_theme <- 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = '#262406',
                                    fill = "#ffffff00"), # Transparent fill
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour = colorspace::darken("#5e5e5e", 0.1),
                                  linewidth = 0.3),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(color = accent_col), # Soft gray text for better readability
        plot.margin = margin(10, 5, 5, 10),
        legend.margin = margin(1, 2, 1, 2)
  )

set_theme(figure_theme)
